options.content: **No validation run yet.** This board compares Sionna ray-tracing against OAI measurements. Both sides are required: Sionna RT is off (`ATG_SIONNA=0`) and the OAI side is limited to the committed sample logs, so no residuals, RMSE, Bland–Altman or gate results exist. Nothing here is back-filled with placeholder numbers — the panels stay empty until `src/validation/` has run against paired data.
